column1: # ZAP baseline rule overrides: <id>\t<IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL>\t<reason>. Keep empty unless a finding is reviewed and accepted.
# INFO keeps a rule's findings in every run's output (listed under INFO); nothing here is IGNORE. Reviewed 2026-11-21, evidence in
# 10049 Non-Storable Content (ZAP risk: Informational). Pages carry a fresh CSP nonce on every response, so they must not be stored by
# caches; API answers are no-store on purpose (they depend on who asks). Being non-storable is the intended, safer behaviour.

column3: (Non-Storable Content: intended, per-request CSP nonce and per-user answers)
